name: Outdoor Food Calculator
tagline: Plan food weight and nutrition for outdoor trips
blurb: Outdoor Food Calculator helps plan food for outdoor trips.
description:
Outdoor Food Calculator helps plan food for outdoor trips.

Features:
* Set trip length and a nutrition profile.
* Add foods by gram amount.
* Save, duplicate, rename, and share calculations.
* Import packaged food data from Open Food Facts.
* Add notes to calculations.

Packaged food data is provided by Open Food Facts, a collaborative food-products database. This data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL): https://wiki.openfoodfacts.org/ODBL_License
